markers.notes: Clear the Thuzadin Acolytes inside this ziggurat after the boss.

markers.notes: Clear the Thuzadin Acolytes inside this ziggurat after the boss.

markers.name: Black Guard Swordsmith
markers.notes: Optional summon from Blacksmithing Plans near Anastari; exact location unverified.

markers.name: Maleki the Pallid
markers.notes: Clear the Thuzadin Acolytes inside this ziggurat after the boss. The three ziggurats may be visited in a different order.

markers.name: Magistrate Barthilas
markers.notes: Late encounter position for a service-gate run. Barthilas can instead be encountered near the entrance when approaching from the main-gate side; that alternative position is not mapped.

markers.name: Ramstein the Gorger
markers.notes: Appears during the Slaughter Square event after clearing the abominations. Subsequent undead waves and Black Guard Sentries must be defeated before the Baron encounter.

markers.name: Aurius
markers.notes: Medallion pickup is in Malor's Strongbox on the live side; this marks Aurius in the chapel.

markers.name: Scourge Data
markers.notes: Repeated in all three ziggurats to mark alternative search locations; only one contains the quest object.
Service Gate; requires the Key to the City or another valid unlocking method.

markers.to: I <-> II: streets leading into the ziggurat district.
II <-> III: access to Slaughter Square is unlocked by clearing all three ziggurats, including their acolytes.
III <-> IV: Slaughterhouse entrance; final access follows the courtyard event.

uncertain: Dashed routes express known connections, not verified street geometry. Room shapes, distances and relative elevations are schematic.
Stonespine patrol and the late Barthilas position are approximate. The alternative early Barthilas location and the main-gate approach are omitted.
The exact street junctions between the three ziggurats are unverified; panel II is a connectivity abstraction, not a literal central crossroads.
The Black Guard Swordsmith plans, Aurius, Scourge Data, ritual symbol and Ysida positions are approximate area markers.
The cross-wing connection to Stratholme Live is not mapped until a shared street layout is verified. Variable crates and roaming quest targets are omitted.
